text:
Maya R: Heads up — seeing a weird packing gap in eu-west1 GPU pool. lots of nodes with 1 GPU free, but scheduler keeps spreading small pods instead of filling. eviction rate spiked to 4% on gpu-worker nodes :eyes:

Josh L: Oof. do you have repro? is it strict topologySpreadConstraints or affinity-taints interplay?

Maya R: Root event at ~10:00 UTC when a batch of small infer pods rolled. quick dump:

```
kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o custom-columns=NODE:.metadata.name,ALLOC:.status.allocatable,ANN:.metadata.annotations --no-headers
node-eu-01   nvidia.com/gpu=8   packing-class=compact
node-eu-02   nvidia.com/gpu=8   packing-class=compact
node-eu-03   nvidia.com/gpu=8   packing-class=compact
```

Many nodes show used GPUs like 7/8 and a few show 0/8 — but the scheduler isn't binpacking, it's launching across lots of nodes.

Priya S: likely two things: 1) pods have anti-affinity for same-node (legacy helm chart), 2) taint + toleration mismatch for spot-preemptible nodes. can you paste pod spec?

Maya R: snippet:

```
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 1
    nvidia.com/gpu: 0.25
affinity:
  podAntiAffinity:
    requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
            - key: app
              operator: In
              values: [inference]
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
tolerations:
  - key: "spot"
    operator: "Exists"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
```

So small fractional-GPU pods, strict required podAntiAffinity, and toleration for "spot" — but spot nodes don't advertise toleration label at scheduling time sometimes (race).

Josh L: fractional GPU requests + required anti-affinity = guaranteed scattering. Scheduler will try to honor anti-affinity across hostnames, so it won't pack onto nodes even if fractional GPUs available. That plus intermittent label propagation -> pods land on on-demand nodes leaving leftover GPUs.

Tom (infra-bot): Alert: eu-west1 gpu-pool average free GPUs per node = 0.9, eviction_rate=0.038, recent scale events suppressed by 15m cooldown.

Priya S: mitigation options (quick):
- change podAntiAffinity to preferredDuringScheduling (so binpack allowed)
- use topologyKey of failure-domain/zone instead of hostname (reduces strictness)
- bump batch job to request 0.5 GPU (less scattering cost)

Maya R: we can’t change app chart quickly for all clusters. any infra-side mitigations?

Josh L: infra fixes:
- set a descheduler policy to remove soft anti-affinity for small pods (dangerous)
- enable binpack-scheduler plugin (we have an experimental alpha) to prefer filled nodes for fractional GPU classes
- temporary node-group drain+recreate with binpack taint to consolidate leftovers (costly)

Priya S: also consider a per-pool admission webhook that rewrites required->preferred for pods < 0.5 GPU. less blast radius than global chart change.

Maya R: can we get a quick experiment: 1) run alpha binpack plugin in eu-west1 staging pool 2) create an admission hook in canary namespace to rewrite antiAffinity -> preferred for <0.5 GPU pods, see scheduling behavior?

Tom (infra-bot): Creating canary policy ticket: INFRA-3421. Assigned to Josh L. ETA 24h for initial canary rollout.

Josh L: I'll spin up a small test. plan: enable plugin on 2 nodes (kube-scheduler flag + rollout), run 50 small pods, measure avg waste and eviction. anyone object?

Priya S: +1. Also instrument a gauge for "fractional_gpu_fragmentation" in console so we can alert before evictions.

Maya R: Cost note: waste currently ~12 GPUs across pool; at eu pricing that's ~€120/hr if left drifting. we should include finance in triage if mitigation >8 hours.

Josh L: ack. will post results and a short runbook. quick patch: for the immediate 1-hour window we can relax the podAntiAffinity via admission hook in the canary namespace (non-prod) to validate benefits.

Maya R: thanks. tagging @Priya S and @Tom (infra-bot) for visibility. :thumbsup:

cluster-bot: Auto-post: Recent rolling updates to inference helm chart introduced required podAntiAffinity by default (change set: chart v3.4.2). See release notes: https://repo.internal/charts/inference/3.4.2

Josh L: that explains it — chart change plus fractional GPU migration. ok will revert chart in next minor for non-prod.

Maya R: good catch. after canary if numbers look good we should apply admission rewrite in prod for 2 hours then roll proper chart fix.

Priya S: filing follow-ups: add console alert, descheduler opt-in doc, and a staging runbook for binpack plugin.

Maya R: I'll monitor. TY all.
